🚫 No-XP Channels

Members earn no XP in these channels. Pick from your servers — no IDs needed.

Loading channels… pick a server in the Leveling page first, then return here.

✅ XP Whitelist

If set, XP is earned ONLY in these channels. Leave empty to allow XP everywhere (except No-XP).

Loading channels…

🧮 XP per Level (Custom curve)

Only used when Formula = Custom. Each row: Total XP needed to reach that level.

🛡️ Who counts as Staff?

Members with any of these roles are on the staff track (staff gift roles + staff announcements). Members with Manage Messages / Kick / Ban / Admin are always treated as staff too.

Loading roles… pick a server in the Leveling page first.

🎁 Level Roles

Both tracks use the same XP curve — only the gift roles differ. “Replaces lower” only affects the same track.

👥 Member Roles
🛡️ Staff Roles

📣 Level-Up Announcements

Staff level-ups go to the staff channel; member level-ups go to the member channel. If a track has no channel, it falls back to the other track.

👥 Member Announcements
🛡️ Staff Announcements

⚡ Role XP Multipliers

Extra XP for members with specific roles (e.g. Booster ×2). Multipliers stack.

🧾 Staff applications

Application questions, open roles, reviewers and the channels applications use.

—
Enabled

Flow: 1. pick a staff role → 2. answer questions (modal) → 3. an Admin approves/denies with buttons. Only admins (Administrator permission or an **Admin**-named role; or the roles below) can review.

Loading roles…
Loading roles… empty = Administrator permission or an “Admin” role.

Applicants see these in a modal, 5 at a time. Keep each short.

Shown on the staff panel next to each role button. Roles without a line get a default line.

Appearance

🖼️ Panels & custom emoji

Panels (staff apps, tickets, temp voice, giveaways) share one look. Point the bot at your emoji server so they use your own emoji.

—
Banner artwork

Leave empty and the bot auto-detects a server with “emoji” in its name.

Map a panel key to an emoji name from your emoji server, or paste the emoji itself.

Overrides the accent colour of every generated banner artwork.

Loading emoji…

Keys used by the panels: staff, staffTeam, designer, developer, eventHost, partnership, ticket, tempvc, giveaway, support, pub, bug, abuse, server, staffReport, donate, link, mouse, check, cross, warning, member, question, clock, sparkles, voice, settings, role, home, arrow, ping, rules, ban, mute, kick, clear, wave, eye, lock, unlock, trash, pencil, crown, shield, logo.

Anything without a match falls back to the bot's own emoji, so panels never break.
